messages:
marta (SEO): quick sync 3 - we need a compact SEO playbook for the product + webinar rollout. scope: keywords, JSON-LD, internal anchor map, canonical strategy, and redirects. keep it execution-focused.

ty (Content): I can draft hero + three supporting briefs. need the canonical decision and which legacy URLs to retire.

vinh (Web): prefer canonical host: https://redwoodinference.com/webinars/production-inference. use 301s for permanent retirements. will surface a redirect list from the staging crawl.

harper (Growth): make sure CTAs append campaign params so paid & organic registrations attribute cleanly. HubSpot form mapping required.

marta (SEO): intent buckets: 1) "low-latency inference" (informational), 2) "inference cost reduction" (commercial), 3) "hosted vs private inference" (comparison). assign keywords per page and prioritize primary+two LSI terms.

ty (Content): I'll add meta titles and 150 char meta descriptions for each page. also will create an anchor-text map for internal linking.

vinh (Web): sample nginx redirect for legacy guide:
```nginx
location = /marketing/old-inference-guide {
  return 301 https://redwoodinference.com/webinars/production-inference;
}
```

marta (SEO): schema checklist: Event (Webinar) JSON-LD on landing, FAQPage JSON-LD for the Q&A section, Organization in header, and BreadcrumbList for the hub. validate with schema validator before deploy.

ty (Content): draft JSON-LD snippet for event (will paste final in CMS head):
```json
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "Event",
  "name": "Production LLM Inference: Tradeoffs and Benchmarks",
  "startDate": "2026-05-12T16:00:00Z",
  "url": "https://redwoodinference.com/webinars/production-inference"
}
```

harper (Growth): tracking params: use `utm_source=organic_site&utm_medium=site&utm_campaign=prod_inference_launch`. Add hidden `campaign_id` input for HubSpot.

marta (SEO): internal linking plan (brief): hero links to benchmark page (anchor "inference benchmarks"), cost playbook ("reduce inference cost"), private deploy guide ("private inference options"). Each support links back to the hero with the same anchors. Add two contextual cross-links between supports.

vinh (Web): sitemap priorities: hero 0.8, supports 0.6. I'll include lastmod timestamps. Also will run a staging crawl and flag duplicate titles/meta lengths.

seo-bot: Staging crawl scheduled 2026-05-02T08:00:00Z 1: will report 301s, 404s, duplicate titles, and meta length warnings.

ty (Content): quick CTA language check: "Join our webinar to see real latency & cost benchmarks". Will ensure H1 and meta align with ads.

marta (SEO): preflight checklist (compact):
- keyword map assigned per page
- JSON-LD validated and injected into CMS head
- 301 redirects mapped & tested on staging
- canonical tags present and authoritative on hero
- sitemap updated and submitted to Search Console
- CTAs have UTM + campaign_id -> HubSpot mapping
- internal anchor map added to content doc
- staging crawl green from seo-bot

harper (Growth): timeline?

marta (SEO): content drafts by 2026-04-22, dev PRs by 04-24, staging QA 04-26, deploy 04-30, webinar 05-12. escalate blockers in channel.

vinh (Web): I'll share the redirect PR and the sitemap change in the release ticket. Expecting the redirect list this afternoon.

ty (Content): will push drafts + FAQ list to the content doc today.

marta (SEO): thanks team 1: keep it lean and testable. :rocket:
